Mattresses: 100-night in-home trial. Must try at least 30 nights before a return.
Unused/unopened within 30 days: free prepaid label, 100% refund once in transit.
Opened (used) between 30–100 days: free return/donation pickup if sanitary.
Toppers: 30-day trial; unopened within 30 days get free label and full refund; opened but sanitary within 30 days can be returned free.
Pillows, bedding, bed frames: Unopened items can be returned within 30 days with a free label and 100% refund. Once opened, they’re not returnable—only covered under warranty.
Refunds: Issued to the original payment method (card, bank, or financing account). Timing is typically 3–5 business days after processing; banks may handle closed/changed accounts by redirecting funds or issuing a check.
Cancellations: If an order isn’t shipped yet, we can cancel and refund. If shipped or delivered, you may refuse delivery or return the intact, unopened package for a refund. Some shipped orders may be intercepted, but this isn’t guaranteed.
How to start a return/refund/claim: Email our Customer Care Team with your Order ID, contact information, photos/videos if applicable, and a brief issue description. We usually respond within 24 business hours, and once a refund is approved, it typically appears in 5–10 business days depending on your bank.
